name: Norwegian Fjords
about: Summer (Jun–Aug) has midnight sun and full-service ports, winter brings snow-capped drama and aurora chances but many cruises pause.
overview: Dramatic cruise-ship scenery through Norway's steep-walled fjords — waterfalls, glaciers, and fishing villages clinging to the water's edge.
costOverview: The Norwegian Fjords run expensive even by Scandinavian standards — coffee and a cinnamon bun alone cost more than a casual lunch in most of Europe, and the classic fjord cruise is a real splurge most visitors budget specifically for.

specialSeasons.text: The midnight sun keeps the fjords lit around the clock.
Long polar nights bring aurora chances, though many cruise lines pause winter sailings.
